feeds.title: Southwest Virginia Cultural Center and Marketplace Blog
feeds.description: The Southwest Virginia Cultural Center and Marketplace serves as the gateway to the vibrant region of Southwest Virginia. Nestled in the Appalachian Mountains, it showcases the rich culture through crafts, music, and local traditions. As a visitor centre and community space, it welcomes all to experience the authentic essence of SWVA.

feeds.title: Art by Kelly Haneklau Blog
feeds.description: Kelly Haneklau, an interdisciplinary artist based in Virginia, specializes in acrylic and oil painting. With a Fine Arts degree from Radford University, she creates commissioned pieces, murals, and illustrations. Kelly's diverse skills include speed painting and jewellery making. Her art philosophy encourages exploring without boundaries, fostering deeper creativity. Stay updated on her latest works and event highlights here.

feeds.title: Ponshop Blog
feeds.description: Ponshop, founded by Gabriel and Scarlett Pons, is a dynamic gallery and retail store in Downtown Fredericksburg. It showcases fine art, ceramics, and handmade items, fostering creativity and community. Regular art events and workshops make it a vibrant cultural hub. Visit their blog for updates.

feeds.title: Abigail Muncy Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Abigail Muncy, a contemporary impressionist painter based in Fairfax, Virginia, draws inspiration from the impressionist tradition and the works of Morisot, Pissarro, and Sorolla. With a background in studio art and art history, she returned to painting after teaching and raising a family, honing her skills through workshops and classes. Passionate about plein-air painting, she captures landscapes and still life vignettes in oils, evoking emotions through her art.

feeds.title: Chrysler Museum of Art
feeds.description: The Chrysler Museum enriches lives by connecting art and people, offering delightful and inspiring experiences. With a diverse staff passionate about art, the museum shares Walter P. Chrysler, Jr.'s extensive collection since 1971, shaping Norfolk's cultural landscape.

feeds.title: Museum of Contemporary Art Arlington
feeds.description: The Museum of Contemporary Art Arlington, a nonprofit art centre founded in 1974, boasts spacious galleries, artist studios, and classrooms. With diverse exhibitions and educational programs, MoCA Arlington fosters community engagement and enriches public life through contemporary art.

feeds.title: Norfolk Arts
feeds.description: Norfolk Arts fosters a vibrant, inclusive arts scene, reflecting and celebrating the community's diversity. They unite, energize, and inspire dialogue, showcasing local artists, galleries, workshops, and events. Stay updated on Norfolk's dynamic art scene with its comprehensive coverage.

feeds.title: Style Weekly » Arts + Culture
feeds.description: Since 1982, Style Weekly has been Richmond's alternative voice, offering smart coverage of news, culture, and arts. With incisive writing and arresting photography, it chronicles the city's complexities and celebrates its energy through thoughtful journalism and sophisticated design.

feeds.title: Linda Matney Gallery
feeds.description: Matney Gallery, founded by John Lee Matney, showcases Southern and international contemporary art in Williamsburg, VA. It offers curated exhibitions, focusing on painting, photography, installation, and sculpture. Dedicated to Linda Matney's legacy, it specializes in Southern figurative art and photography, providing a platform for significant contemporary works.

feeds.title: Workhouse Arts Center
feeds.description: The Workhouse Arts Foundation fosters a thriving arts hub, offering diverse opportunities in visual and performing arts, education, and community engagement. Supporting over 65 artists with affordable studios, it hosts programs like W3 Theatre, Lucy Burns Museum, and Art of Movement, along with extensive arts education classes for all.

feeds.title: Art Factory Blog
feeds.description: Art Factory, nestled in Brandermill Market Square, provides a creative haven where families can unleash their inner artists. With open workshops, self-guided projects, and instructed classes, it's a hub for creativity. Their spacious party rooms cater to various events, from birthdays to team building, ensuring memorable experiences for all ages.

feeds.title: Virginia Museum of Fine Arts Blog
feeds.description: The Virginia Museum of Fine Arts, a state-supported institution, aims to enrich the lives of Virginians by collecting, preserving, exhibiting, and interpreting art. It encourages art study and serves as a cultural resource for the Commonwealth.

feeds.title: Central Virginia Watercolor Guild
feeds.description: The Central Virginia Watercolor Guild fosters excellence in water-media painting, educates the public, promotes the study of the medium, and facilitates information exchange among artists. They strive to advance the art form and engage the community in appreciating watercolour.
